privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How ZNBSYS collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how we handle personal information when you use this website. We collect the minimum needed to provide our services.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you contact us through the form, you voluntarily provide your name, email, company and project details; these are used only to reply to you. The site runs no third-party tracking scripts and requires no account registration.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use the information to answer your inquiry, prepare proposals and quotes, and — with your consent — to keep records of project-related communication. We never use it for advertising and never sell it.

sections.heading: Sharing, storage and security
paragraphs: We do not share personal information with third parties unless required by law or unless you agree in advance. Data lives in access-controlled hosting with reasonable transport and storage protections, and is kept only as long as needed.

sections.heading: Your rights and contact
paragraphs: You may access, correct or request deletion of the personal information we hold. To do so, or to ask questions about this policy, write to znbsys@outlook.com — we reply within 15 business days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: ZNBSYS terms covering collaboration, payment, intellectual property and liability.
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of this website and to working with us, unless a separate signed agreement states otherwise.

sections.heading: Scope of services
paragraphs: We provide design, development, deployment and maintenance for websites and web applications. Deliverables and milestones are defined in the project proposal or contract; content on this site is not an offer.

sections.heading: Collaboration and payment
paragraphs: Projects progress against agreed milestones and payment schedules; you provide required materials and feedback on time. Significant scope changes are evaluated separately for schedule and cost.

sections.heading: Intellectual property and confidentiality
paragraphs: Ownership of deliverables transfers as defined in the contract after full payment; we may reuse general technical approaches in other projects without disclosing your confidential information. Both parties keep confidential information secret.

sections.heading: Liability and changes
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of this site or our services. We may update these terms from time to time; the version published on this page takes effect immediately.
